sloka: मया प्रतिगृहीते तु तस्मिन्नाभरणे शुभे ।मानुषः पूर्वको देहो राजर्षेर्विननाश ह ।। ७.७८.२८ ॥
transliteration: mayā pratigṛhīte tu tasminnābharaṇe śubhe ।mānuṣaḥ pūrvako deho rājarṣervinanāśa ha ।। 7.78.28 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, as soon as that auspicious ornament was accepted by me, the former human body of that royal sage perished.
